title: Continual Policy Consolidation for Lifelong Robot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.22475v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Building a generalist robot policy requires continuously integrating new skills while preserving previously acquired behaviors. Directly optimizing a single policy over a growing task stream is difficult because robotic interaction is expensive, task distributions are heterogeneous, and sequential updates induce interference. To address these problems, we propose continual policy consolidation (CPC), a teacher--student framework that combines continual policy distillation with prioritized experience replay and expandable experts. This architecture separates skill acquisition from policy consolidation: teachers are trained independently through reinforcement learning, and their behaviors are continually distilled into a central generalist student. This decomposition retains the practical strength of reinforcement learning for task-specialized training while casting student-side consolidation as a supervised policy-learning problem. To

translated_title: 面向终身机器人学习的持续策略巩固
translated_abstract: 构建通用机器人策略需要在持续集成新技能的同时保留已习得的行为。由于机器人交互成本高昂、任务分布异构、且顺序更新会引发干扰，直接在持续增长的任务流上优化单一策略十分困难。为解决这些问题，我们提出了持续策略巩固（CPC），这是一种结合持续策略蒸馏、优先经验回放和可扩展专家的教师-学生框架。该架构将技能习得与策略巩固相分离：教师通过强化学习独立训练，其行为被持续蒸馏到一个中心化的通用学生策略中。这种分解既保留了强化学习在任务专用训练方面的实用优势，又将学生端的策略巩固转化为一个有监督的策略学习问题。
tldr: 提出持续策略巩固（CPC）教师-学生框架，通过持续策略蒸馏、优先经验回放和可扩展专家，将强化学习驱动的技能习得与有监督的策略巩固相分离，使机器人能够终身学习新技能的同时保留已习得的行为。
en_tdlr: Proposes Continual Policy Consolidation (CPC), a teacher-student framework combining continual policy distillation, prioritized experience replay, and expandable experts that decouples RL-based skill acquisition from supervised policy consolidation, enabling lifelong robot learning that integrates new skills while preserving previously acquired behaviors.
